title: Tight Lower Bounds for Stochastic Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We study the stochastic first-order oracle complexity of finding $ε$-stationary points of the primal function in smooth nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization. For sufficiently small $ε$, we establish lower bounds of $Ω(κLΔσ^2ε^{-4})$ under the bounded-variance assumption and $Ω(κ^{3/2}\bar LΔσε^{-3})$ under the additional assumption of averaged smoothness.
